title: Start with the outcome people need

elements.text: A capability is a reusable ability offered to consumers, with an owner and a service promise.

items: Name the consumer and the job they need to complete.
Define what the producer provides and supports.
Choose the implementation after testing the need.

elements.alt: APIOps human scene illustrating that an API alone does not define a useful capability

elements.text: Example: let suppliers and service teams understand payment progress without repeated status enquiries.

notes:
The method description explicitly avoids assuming implementation style in advance. A capability might be accessed through APIs, events, integrations or automation. This is not an organisational maturity assessment.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
